## Safety check

- [ ] add a new command/flag (does anything fail closed differently?)
- [ ] change restore/conflict semantics (needs discussion first — see docs/TRANSACTION_MODEL.md)
- [ ] only change docs/output text (lowest risk, welcome)

## Alternatives considered
